name: Microgrid standby-controller ownership interface
aliases: microgrids Microgrid supervisory and communication interfaces
summary: Identifies the documented transfer of supervisory ownership between controller instances.
description: Identifies the documented transfer of supervisory ownership between controller instances. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Controller availability and authority” at the input and “Selected supervisory controller” at the output. Redundancy depends on the complete architecture.
